mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_browse_history (user_id, sku_id, browse_count, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{skuId}, 1, NOW(), NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE browse_count = browse_count + 1, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT p.category3_id AS categoryId, COUNT(*) AS browseCount FROM user_browse_history ubh INNER JOIN product_sku ps ON ubh.sku_id = ps.id INNER JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.id WHERE ubh.user_id = #{userId} AND ubh.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 GROUP BY p.category3_id ORDER BY browseCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
